_meta.provenance: DIRECTIVE-GAZETTEER-1 Phase 1 — per-system HISTORY FACTS distilled from Sarna.net BattleTechWiki planet + battle articles via the MediaWiki API (facts only: dates, page titles, participants; NO wiki text is reproduced; every row carries its source URL). Sources: political-affiliation = the Political Affiliation ownership timeline (change-of-hands); battle-infobox = {{InfoBoxBattle}}/{{InfoBoxConflict}} articles keyed by planet; linked-event = an event article the planet page links (title + year only).

_meta.eraRule: eraId = the wizard era (eras.ts) whose [start,end] contains `year`; years before 2005 → era 1; multi-year events file under their START year
_meta.fields: systemId year endYear? eraId kind name planet? participants[] from[]? to[]? commanders[]? commands[]? partOf? confidence source sarnaUrl cited
_meta.notes: linked-event rows are named by the RESOLVED article title (the planet page may link a redirect, e.g. "Battle of Terra (2766)" → "Amaris Civil War"; a year in the linked title counts as explicit); commands lists up to 12 linked named formations (large orders of battle are truncated); commanders are linked persons (office/rank links filtered); no outcome field by ruling; participants is always present (empty for linked-event rows).
